functions.description: Extract syslog header fields: timestamp, host, pid, severity, message
Extract source IP and optional port from messages containing 'from <ip>[:port]'
Extract destination IP and port from trap/send messages containing 'to <ip>:<port>'
Extract SNMPv3 user field when present
Classify action type and set protocol based on message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/Authentication failure|authentication failed|brute force/i) ? 'authentication_failure' : message.match(/GETBULK request|GET request|SET request|authenticated GET request/i) ? 'snmp_request' : message.match(/trap/i) ? 'trap' : message.match(/started successfully|Loaded MIB/i) ? 'startup' : message.match(/Failed to bind|Timeout waiting/i) ? 'error' : message.match(/Malformed SNMP PDU/i) ? 'malformed_packet' : message.match(/configuration reloaded/i) ? 'config_reload' : 'other'
